title: John was determined to take on a part-time job to make ______ money for his upcoming schooling.
hint:
1.John was determined to take on a part-time job to make extra money for his upcoming schooling.
（約翰決心打工，為即將到來的學業賺取額外的錢。）
  • be determined to + 原形動詞 = 決心做某事（意志堅定，非做不可）
    • 例句：
      • She is determined to finish the project by Friday.（她決心週五前完成專案。）
      • They were determined to win the championship.（他們矢言奪冠。）
    • 常考替換選項（如果出現在同義題）：
      • made up his mind to
  • extra（額外的）：打工的目的是在既有收入（或生活費）之外，多賺一筆錢來支付學費或開銷。這是最自然、最常見的搭配（make extra money 是固定用法）。
    • 常見搭配 extra money / extra time / extra charge
    • 例句 I need extra time to finish the project.
    • 近義字
      • additional 附加的（較正式）; 常見搭配 additional fee / additional information ; 例句 There is an additional fee for baggage.
      • spare 多餘的（閒置、未使用的）; 常見搭配 spare key / spare time ; 例句 Can you lend me a spare pen?
  • harsh（嚴酷的／刺耳的）：不能用來修飾 money。我們只會說 harsh weather（惡劣天氣）或 harsh punishment（嚴厲懲罰）。
  • marital（婚姻的）：只能用於婚姻相關，如 marital status（婚姻狀況）。與金錢無關。
  • unique（獨特的）：指「獨一無二的」，金錢本身沒有「獨特」與否的問題，語意不合。

title: Imagine a world where machines are our teachers, our friends, and our companions and where they can drive our cars, diagnose our diseases, and even write our creative content. This is the world of artificial intelligence (AI), and it is a future that is already starting to take    21   . In movies like The Matrix and Terminator, AI is often    22    as a threat to humanity. But in reality, AI has the potential to be a powerful tool for good. It can help us    23    some of the world's biggest problems, such as climate change, disease, and poverty. AI is already being used in a variety of ways today. For example, Tesla, Waymo, and other companies are developing self-driving cars that use AI to    24    the road and avoid obstacles. Amazon and other online retailers use AI to recommend products to customers    25    their past purchases and browsing history. It's also being used to develop new products and services, such as personalized shopping recommendations and AI-powered chatbots.

subItems.hint:
21. This is the world of artificial intelligence (AI), and it is a future that is already starting to take shape.
（這就是人工智慧（AI）的世界，而這個未來已經開始成形。）
  • This is the world of artificial intelligence (AI) = 這就是人工智慧的世界
  • it is a future = 這是一個未來
  • that is already starting to take shape = 已經開始成形的（關係子句，修飾 a future）
take shape 關鍵用法
  • take shape（固定片語）= 成形、具體化、逐漸實現
  • take shape 是一個慣用語，用來描述 「想法、計畫、未來等從模糊變得具體、從概念變成現實」 的過程。
  • 本題的主詞是 a future（一個未來），搭配 is already starting to take shape，表示「這個未來已經開始逐漸實現／成形」。
    • 例句：
  • The plan for the new building is finally taking shape.（新大樓的計畫終於逐漸成形了。）
  • Her ideas began to take shape after months of research.（經過數月的研究，她的想法開始具體化。）
其他選項
  • turns（轉變、輪到） => ❌ ...a future that is already starting to take turns.
    • take turns 是一個片語，意思是「輪流」，如 We take turns doing the dishes.（我們輪流洗碗）。
    • 但「未來」不會「輪流」——未來是持續發展的，不是輪流進行的。語意完全不合。
    • 正確用法例句（對比）： We take turns cleaning the room.（我們輪流打掃房間。）— take turns 用於「輪流做某事」，不適用於「未來的發展」。
  • notes（筆記、音符） => ❌ ...a future that is already starting to take notes.
    • take notes 是一個片語，意思是「記筆記」。
    • 但「未來」不會「記筆記」——未來是「發生」或「成形」的，不是「被記錄」的。語意完全不合。
    • 正確用法例句（對比）： She took notes during the lecture.（她在課堂上記了筆記。）— take notes 用於「人記錄資訊」，不適用於「未來的發展」。
  • block（街區、障礙物） => ❌...a future that is already starting to take block.
    • take block 不是英文中的正確片語。
    • 我們會說 roadblock（路障）或 block something（阻擋某物），但 take block 沒有意義。語法錯誤且語意不通。
    • 正確用法例句（對比）： The police set up a roadblock.（警方設置了路障。）— block 作為名詞是「障礙物」，但 take block 不是正確片語。
前後語意邏輯
  • 題目說：「這就是人工智慧的世界，而這個未來已經開始 _____。」
  • 前文描述了 AI 的各種應用（機器當老師、開車、診斷疾病等）——這些都是具體的、正在發生的事情。
  • 因此，這個「未來」已經不是純粹的想像，而是正在逐漸實現中。
  • 表達「逐漸實現」的固定片語就是 take shape。
    • shape 成形 ✅ 正確
    • turns 輪流語意不合（未來不會「輪流」）
    • notes 記筆記語意不合（未來不會「記筆記」）
    • block 阻擋不是正確片語
全句完整語意
  • 這就是人工智慧的世界（This is the world of artificial intelligence）， 而這個未來已經開始成形（and it is a future that is already starting to take shape）。
文法亮點： that is already starting to take shape 關係子句
  • that is already starting to take shape 是關係子句，修飾前面的 a future。
  • starting to + 原形動詞 = 開始做某事（這裡是 start to take shape）。
  • 類似結構例句： The project is starting to take shape.（該專案開始成形了。）
